title.narrative: L3-107 Healthpoint Services India entrepreneurial support

description.narrative: Använda ICT för att ställa diagnoser i rural Indien. Avtalspart är Healthpoint Services India Pvt. Ltd., org.nr Ue5100DL2009PTc2274e3, Indien.

Technology enalbed Rural chronic Care Managment - Use of advanced mobiel diagnostic & communication tools. Agreement partner is Healthpoint Services India Pvt. Ltd., org reg no Ue5100DL2009PTc2274e3, India.

Although it is quite difficult to make a thorough assessment as to whether the intervention objectives were reached, the initial reports in the earlier years indicate that the planned objectives were achieved. A decision has been taken to close the project without some of the required reporting from the partner. HealthPoint has been unresponsive at some point as regards reporting is concerned. For a long time, Sida had continuously requested for proper or agreed reports (Narrative and Financial completion & Audit) from the partner but this became a difficult issue. Similarly, the received audit certificate indicated that the CEO received 95% of the intervention funds as personal salary. Upon assessment, Sida decided to request for the reimbursement of funds but upon further consideration, this route was not viable, hence deciding on closing the project.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
